blocks.text: 🪝 SEBI Proposes Wider FPI Participation in Non-Agricultural Commodity Derivatives. Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: SEBI proposed allowing FPIs in non-agri index derivatives and physically settled contracts with 2-tier safeguard mechanism.
**Expanded Scope:** FPIs allowed in non-cash-settled and physically settled non-agricultural commodity derivatives.
**Two-Tier Safeguard:** Voluntary exit before delivery period; automatic position transfer to designated Trading Member (TM/TCM) as backstop.
**Settlement Rules:** Transferred position executed at settlement price; TM/TCM given **2 trading days** to align position limits.
≠ **Position Transfer Limit:** TM/TCM allowed up to 2 trading days to bring positions within limit.
🎯 Exam Angle → Focus on statutory circular guidelines, compliance deadlines, penal provisions, and applicability thresholds across scheduled banks.
